sources.title: Independent time/sample/sine/phase/prefix derivation
sources.details: t=n/16000,y[n]=0.5*sin(2*pi*f*n/16000),N=round(0.1*16000)=1600. At440Hz, n1 progress0.0275 and y1=0.08596455013970478,y2=0.1693689601226457; at880Hz, progress0.055,y1=0.1693689601226457,y2=0.3187119948743449. N/fs=0.1s; last timestamp1599/fs=0.0999375s. Nominal cycles44/88. Ideal progress0,.25,.5,.75,1 gives0,.5,0,-.5,0. Amplitude multiplier is separate from frequency/phase; current helper fixes0.5. Two arbitrary sequences can share first3 values but differ later, so prefix cannot identify all recording content. Full substitution/results in a_analysis and a_cpu.
